notes: cics-crucible commarea-mismatch / ca-xctl-versions (Apache-2.0 corpus, owner OK 2026-10-31 for the ladder, #6072), the front program CAXA (#7434, harness: #6271 layout_only): its XCTL passes a WORKING-STORAGE item (WS-V1 for 10 and 80 bytes, WS-BIG past the 32767-byte limit), which the forge makes an entity, so the case states WS-BLOCK as the LAYOUT of the XCTL area only (no DTO, bytes compared through the layout). The scenarios restate the crucible's terminal steps; the oracle is GnuCOBOL plus the stub, not the crucible's hand-written logs.

scenarios.name: xctl-short-10
scenarios.why: XCTL COMMAREA(WS-V1) LENGTH(10): CAXB is entered with EIBCALEN 10

scenarios.name: xctl-long-80
scenarios.why: XCTL COMMAREA(WS-V1) LENGTH(80): the 80 bytes run on into WS-NEIGHBOUR, the version-1 area's neighbour storage

scenarios.name: xctl-big-length
scenarios.why: XCTL COMMAREA(WS-BIG) LENGTH(32767) with RESP: the length past what the area may be
